summary: Antonio Reeves hit a floater with 2.3 seconds left to give Minnesota a 125-124 win in Miami, and Washington beat Detroit 114-108 in overtime after the Pistons rallied from 20 down to force the extra period. Boston routed Philadelphia 144-106 behind Payton Pritchard's 25 points, and Toronto led by as many as 21 in a 114-106 win over the Clippers in Vancouver. Atlanta, Golden State and Phoenix all held off late rallies in close wins.

games.headline: Raptors hold off Clippers in Vancouver, 114-106
games.story: Toronto took the lead for good on RJ Barrett's 3-pointer 52 seconds into the game and pushed it to 21 points in the third quarter. Barrett led all scorers with 20 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists, Immanuel Quickley made 5 of 6 threes for 18 points, and Scottie Barnes added 12 points and 10 rebounds. The Clippers won the fourth quarter 34-25 and pulled within 95-89 on a 7-0 run, but the Raptors answered with a 14-6 stretch. Rui Hachimura scored 14 for the Clippers, who were without Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram, while Kawhi Leonard did not play for Toronto.

games.headline: Hawks hold off late Pacers rally to win 119-117
games.story: Atlanta went ahead for good at 70-67 on an Onyeka Okongwu 3-pointer early in the third quarter and led 96-86 after three. Indiana opened the fourth on an 8-0 run, later scored eight straight to get within 114-113 with 1:07 left, and was down 118-117 with 20 seconds to go before RayJ Dennis's free throw set the final. Jalen Johnson led all scorers with 20 points and 7 rebounds, and Okongwu added 18. Pascal Siakam and Kelly Oubre Jr. scored 13 apiece for the Pacers, who were without Tyrese Haliburton.

games.headline: Wizards outlast Pistons in overtime, 114-108
games.story: Tre Johnson hit four 3-pointers in the first quarter as Washington built a 40-20 lead after one. Detroit opened the second with a 12-0 run, won the quarter 30-16 and trailed 56-50 at the half. The Pistons took the third and fourth quarters, 28-24 and 20-18, to force overtime at 98-98, but the Wizards won the extra period 16-10. Cade Cunningham and Jalen Duren did not play for Detroit.

games.headline: Reeves floater with 2.3 left lifts Wolves past Heat
games.story: Minnesota led by as many as 14 in the third quarter, but Miami opened the fourth on an 8-0 run and went up 106-100 with 6:22 left. The Timberwolves answered with 10 straight points, and after Vladislav Goldin's three-point play put the Heat ahead 124-123 with 14.8 seconds to go, Antonio Reeves hit a floater with 2.3 seconds left to win it. Bones Hyland led Minnesota with 23 points on 5-of-6 shooting from three, and Zyon Pullin added 22 while making all 8 of his free throws. Ryan Conwell had 22 points and 9 assists for Miami, and Goldin scored 18.

games.headline: Celtics rout 76ers 144-106 as Pritchard scores 25
games.story: Philadelphia scored the first eight points, but Boston took the lead for good at 19-18 late in the first quarter. The Celtics won the second quarter 39-22 to lead 63-42 at halftime, then pushed the margin to 35 after three and as many as 45 in the fourth. Payton Pritchard had 25 points, seven assists and five 3-pointers in 24 minutes, Jayson Tatum added 23, and Boston made 22 threes. VJ Edgecombe led Philadelphia with 19 points and four steals, while Joel Embiid, LeBron James and Jaylen Brown did not play for the 76ers.

games.headline: Lendeborg, Warriors hold off Kings 111-106
games.story: Golden State trailed 51-48 after a 10-0 Sacramento run in the second quarter, then closed the half on a 7-0 run to lead 61-56. Brandin Podziemski hit back-to-back 3-pointers to put the Warriors ahead for good at 72-70 midway through the third, and they stretched the lead to 103-93 in the fourth. The Kings answered with eight straight points to get within 103-101 but got no closer. Yaxel Lendeborg had 23 points, 10 rebounds and 6 assists for Golden State, while Darius Acuff Jr. led all scorers with 25 points and 8 assists for Sacramento.

games.headline: Suns hold off late Spurs push, 102-98
games.story: Phoenix went ahead for good with a 13-0 run in the first quarter and led by as many as 15 before the period ended. The Suns never trailed again and were up 102-90 with 1:44 left before San Antonio scored the last eight points of the game. Luke Kennard led all scorers with 20 points and four 3-pointers, Jalen Green added 18, and Khaman Maluach had 10 points and 15 rebounds. Dylan Harper led the Spurs with 15 points and Victor Wembanyama had 13 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists, while Phoenix was without Devin Booker and San Antonio did not have De'Aaron Fox.
